violations.text: Quaternary ammonium sanitizer solution in the sanitizer bucket was in excess of 400 parts per million (ppm). A quaternary ammonia sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be applied at the strength as indicated on the manufacturers' label. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026
Spray bottle used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies was not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Chili was observed cooling on the counter in a container greater than 4 inches deep. Proper cooling methods reviewed. Chili was separated into smaller containers. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026

Working thermometers are lacking in refrigeration unit(s). All cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer inside the unit that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

Working container of a dry ingredient observed not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026

Refrigerator door gaskets of the prep unit were observed in poor repair. Gaskets are being held in place with tape. Tape is not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Gaskets must be replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dishwasher and the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for sanitizer buckets. Both test strips must be obtained. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the condenser fan guards in the walk-in cooler and the shelving throughout the facility have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026
Leak observed under the 3-bay sink. Plumbing must be maintained in good repair. Leak is to be properly repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Employee certified in food safety management must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2025

Thermometers are lacking inside the 2-door lowboy, the front 2-door reach-in, and the walk-in cooler. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2025
Refrigerator door gaskets of the prep unit were observed in poor repair, splitting away from the doors. Gaskets must be replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dishwasher. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in condenser fans, the walk-in shelving, and the dish racks have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2025
The walls in the kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2024

Foods are served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2023
Refrigerator door gaskets of the prep unit were observed in poor repair, splitting away from the doors. Gaskets are to be replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2024
The floor in the cook/grill area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2024

The walls throughout the kitchen observed with an accumulation of grease, soil residue, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/28/2024
